english.note: Use 雕塑 as the all-purpose term for sculpture as an art form or for a sculpted artwork when the specific object is not being emphasized.

examples.english: I really liked studying sculpture when I was young.
examples.traditional: 我細個嗰陣好鍾意學雕塑。
